name: OVO-Bench_data_chunked_videos
description: A chunked video dataset intended for open-vocabulary video benchmarking: supports retrieval and captioning-style tasks over short video segments. It measures models' ability to match natural-language queries to relevant video chunks and to produce descriptive captions for video content.
evaluation_method: Retrieval: Recall@K / mAP; Captioning: CIDEr / BLEU
reputation: A focused dataset on Hugging Face for open-vocabulary video research with limited but growing usage in specialized research groups.
